tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Returns the user's latest portfolio snapshot: balances per network (ETH, SOL, BTC, ADA), exchanges (CEX), DeFi and manual assets.

tools.name: get_wallets
tools.description: Returns the wallets of each portfolio, with addresses as pseudonyms (wallet_…), never in clear.

tools.name: get_pnl
tools.description: The user's portfolio performance in euros: current total and change over 24 h, 7 days, 30 days and since the start, from the saved snapshots.

tools.name: get_realized_gains
tools.description: The user's realised capital gains using FIFO, in euros, with fees and gas deducted: total, per asset and per year. Not a tax return.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Advanced portfolio metrics from the saved history: ROI, CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, volatility, maximum and current drawdown, win rate and 95% VaR.

tools.name: get_trades
tools.description: Transactions recorded by the user (buys, sells and fees), in euros, newest first. Optional filters by asset and year.

tools.name: get_tax_estimate
tools.description: ESTIMATE of capital-gains tax in a country, in that country's currency: the country's cost method (FIFO, average cost, LIFO, UK pooling, annual sum), each trade converted at the ECB rate of its date, the rules of the year of sale, holding period, annual allowance and, where the law allows, losses ca

tools.name: list_tax_countries
tools.description: Crypto tax regimes published by ChainFolioAI: short- and long-term rate, holding period, annual allowance and legal reference, per country.

tools.name: get_global_market
tools.description: Global crypto market state: total market cap, 24 h change and Bitcoin and Ethereum dominance.

tools.name: get_derivatives
tools.description: Derivatives data for a symbol on OKX: open interest, long/short ratio, funding, CVD, taker volume, 1 h candles, put/call and a composite sentiment score (0–100).

tools.name: get_price_on
tools.description: Closing price in US dollars of a crypto asset on a date (UTC), from OKX daily candles. Useful to value a past buy or sale.

tools.name: get_defi_positions
tools.description: The user's lending positions read from the contracts (Aave V3, Spark, Compound V3, Morpho, EigenLayer) on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism and Polygon: supplied, borrowed and net, with health factor. It queries the blockchain, so it takes a few seconds.

tools.name: get_nfts
tools.description: NFTs in the user's EVM wallets on one network. They are not included in the portfolio total (no reliable price).

tools.name: get_portfolio_score
tools.description: The user's portfolio score (0–100), as shown in the app: diversification, crypto/traditional mix, stablecoin reserve, performance and risk management. A reading aid, not a recommendation to buy or sell.

tools.name: get_whale_activity
tools.description: Scans the given addresses and returns recent on-chain movements (large transfers, accumulation). Supports ETH, BTC and SOL.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Returns the top crypto assets by market cap (price, market cap, volume, 24h and 7d change).

tools.name: list_known_whales
tools.description: Lists the preloaded known whales (exchanges, funds, public figures, governments) with address and chain. Use the addresses as input to get_whale_activity.

tools.name: get_fear_greed
tools.description: Crypto market Fear & Greed index (current value 0–100, classification and recent history).

tools.name: get_asset
tools.description: Price, market cap, volume and change (24h/7d) of a crypto asset by symbol (e.g. btc, eth, sol).

tools.name: get_fire
tools.description: Calculates the years to financial independence (4% rule) from expenses, savings, return and age.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Latest crypto news (CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph): title, source, link and date.

tools.name: get_btc_blocks
tools.description: Recent Bitcoin blocks (height, number of transactions, median fee, pool) and recommended mempool fees.

tools.name: ask_ai
tools.description: Ask the AI assistant, in natural language, about your real portfolio (analysis, context, risks). It never gives buy or sell orders. Daily limit per account.
